findings.frozen_requirement: engineering_successor.lock_compatibility retains execution_approval and fields approved_base_commit, specification_sha256, execution_plan_sha256, protocol_hashes, python, resource_policy, allowed_verifier_transitions; sidecar plan is hash-bound.
observations: Schema requires finite_yaml_lock, has additionalProperties:false, and contains no execution_approval envelope or approved_base_commit, execution_plan_sha256, allowed_verifier_transitions fields.

validate_lock accepts a syntactically shaped disposable self-constructed metadata fixture after only an external matching digest and partial claim comparison; there is no committed plan/approval/claim-file verification in this interface.
This differs from the frozen contract even though all integration bytes are correctly archived. A future real lock would require engineering changes, not only filling prospective values.

findings.frozen_requirement: Exact two-cell/five-case mapping must be accepted only with its own specification/configuration and verified pre-import launch; additive wrappers must integrate the immutable kernels.
observations: All seven reserved RUN IDs were accepted by validate_lock when paired with the correct original specification hash but deliberately wrong cell or six-field configuration in argv. These were validation-only calls; no reserved run directory or kernel was invoked.
EXP-ECDLP-abf981 paired with incidence RUN-ECDLP-3c6277 was also accepted. The adapter checks identifier shape/equality only.

Both source-v2 wrapper files invoked with a nonexistent lock return exit 0 and no output: neither has argument parsing or a main dispatcher. Their callable bodies invoke _import_archived_kernel before any launch validation. Static source review finds no validate_lock/execute_locked call and no verified token argument.
The twelve-case static metadata helper is separate from run_locked_case and is not called during its forwarding call. No scientific forwarding call was performed in QA.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Wire a gated additive entry CLI/child interface, derive exact seven configurations and paths from hash-pinned immutable definitions, and refuse mismatches before imports/output. Exercise only benign forwarding sentinels during engineering tests; real scientific authority remains separately required.
findings.title: Reserved configuration membership is not checked and source-v2 entries are not wired launch interfaces

findings.frozen_requirement: Exact live task/claim/owner/epoch/expiry and real native receipt must be bound; no Bedrock, fallback/degradation, or unprobed model_verified promotion.
observations: Mismatched branch and session, an expired lock reference paired with a fresh caller claim, a caller claim acquired in 2099, a mismatched receipt session, and a wrong metric-decision hash all passed admission.

A native receipt containing provider BEDROCK passed admission. A prohibited marker in the separate caller authority was correctly refused. The provider test was metadata only; no network/model call occurred.
model_verified:true with adapter_probe_performed:false and fallback/degradation with low effort passed admission.
Every observed generated manifest omitted native_launch_receipt entirely. The separate engineering author report does not discharge the adapter launch-provenance requirement.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Bind and compare all canonical claim fields and the actual native receipt, verify acquisition/expiry and task/run membership, validate the decision reference, refuse prohibited/fallback/degraded provenance, and preserve exact observed provenance in the terminal record.
findings.title: Claim and native provenance checks do not enforce the complete bound authority

findings.frozen_requirement: Complete imported source closure, actual executable path/version/hash, dependency pins and environment allowlist must be bound.
observations: The declared executable hash can be correct while argv[0] names a different nonexistent executable; validation accepted it. An invented executable version was accepted.
A source_closure containing only the benign child-config JSON was accepted despite omitting the executed program, adapter, core runner, records, budget module and PyYAML dependency.
environment_allowlist:[] did not prevent a benign child from observing the deliberately supplied FINITE_YAML_QA_CANARY environment variable. Only this synthetic canary was tested; no secret was read.
The emitted environment companion contains dependencies:{} and a fixed selected_environment list, rather than binding the lock allowlist or relevant dependency versions/hashes.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Compare normalized argv[0] and runtime version/hash to the pinned executable, establish and verify complete import/dependency closure, and launch with an explicitly constructed allowed environment. Record actual pins and companion values.
findings.title: Executable, import closure and environment declarations are not enforced

findings.frozen_requirement: Protocol/claim/lock/source drift must refuse before scientific import; postflight must check raw specification, lock, source closure and approved commit/tree state.
limitations: No actual completed_valid bypass was demonstrated. Missing postflight checks are established by source plus per-check diagnostics; clean-tree end-to-end validity remains untested.
observations: After normal validate_lock, modifying the benign child source, the synthetic lock or the synthetic specification still allowed execute_locked to launch the child and create output.

A claim that was valid during validate_lock expired naturally before execute_locked; the benign child still entered. This control used the real clock and did not mutate the VerifiedLaunch or bypass admission.
The frozen dataclass contains mutable argv/dict members; a separately labeled mutation control altered the accepted authority expiry and it was used without revalidation.

For postlaunch lock and specification mutation, source_closure_unchanged stayed true because these files are not automatically included in protocol_files. Manifest checks contain neither approval_lock_unchanged nor specification_unchanged nor commit_unchanged.

Uncommitted reviewer scratch caused tree_unchanged_except_run_dir:false for baseline and attack cases, so actual terminal manifests remained failed_infrastructure. This confound was preserved; QA did not bypass the tree check or observe completed_valid under drift.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Revalidate current claim, immutable launch data, lock/spec/source file identity and approved Git state before mkdir/exec; automatically bind all protocol files and compare them independently after child quiescence. Provide an explicitly approved synthetic fixture tree-state policy so a clean positive case can be tested without masking specific negative controls.
findings.title: Launch-time revalidation and independent postflight bindings are missing

findings.frozen_requirement: Exact output allowlist, no symlink/hardlink aliases, full hashing, exclusive manifest-last/fsync and partial preservation are required.
observations: A child-created raw-result.json symlink to a scratch-only protected sentinel caused the parent adapter to overwrite that target with its raw result. A hardlink fixture caused the same overwrite. Both targets and post-write bytes are retained.
An undeclared child file remained present and absent from the manifest hash map; the declared output_allowlist is copied into VerifiedLaunch and never consumed by execute_locked.
Admission accepted duplicate/traversing output names and a run-directory ancestor symlink or internal parent traversal.
Each manifest hashes exactly five companion files; arbitrary child artifacts, required profile files and symlink identity are not inspected.

Existing directory creation is correctly exclusive, and a preexisting child manifest is refused. However the final manifest code uses exists/is_symlink followed by write_text (mode w), with no O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW or fsync. The concurrent file-creation race was identified statically and was not raced experimentally.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Use canonical paths, exclusive non-following file creation and inode/link checks for every parent-owned artifact; validate complete final directory membership, missing outputs and all hashes; fsync the exclusive terminal manifest last. Preserve already-produced collision/failure evidence in a distinct permitted terminal diagnostic.
findings.title: Output allowlist and no-clobber protections fail for child artifacts

findings.frozen_requirement: Preserve every original filename, add the exact five companions prospectively, and validate terminal YAML against the current applicable ledger checks.
observations: The actual models specification requires ten per-run names, including stdout.txt and stderr.txt. Its source-v2 candidate plan/documentation describe seven scientific names plus manifest and omit both frozen text logs.

Independent benign profile fixtures emitted the original ten models names or twelve incidence names (manifest owned by parent), plus the exact five companions. All nine models nonmanifest originals and all eleven incidence nonmanifest originals are absent from the parent manifest artifact hash map.

Each examined generated manifest failed the actual unmodified applicable ledger check with expected top-level key run. The adapter emits finite_yaml_locked_run and lacks required code/inputs/result structure, execution commit and real model provenance.

The ledger checker was invoked by extracting its unchanged Ctx/load_yaml/check_run definitions, avoiding unrelated registry reads; it failed on its real first shape check. No schema, legacy baseline, record or checker was weakened.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Emit the existing run envelope with current fields and all original plus authorized companion paths; preserve both text-log names for both profiles. Validate real synthetic terminal files using the applicable ledger checks and current schema before claiming engineering completion.
findings.title: Both frozen output profiles and current ledger manifests are incomplete

findings.frozen_requirement: Demonstrate low synthetic memory/watchdog/worker enforcement, process group quiescence, and truthful operational failure classification; schema version/type errors must refuse.
observations: Normal admission and execution on non-root macOS demonstrated a 24 MiB RSS limit killing a benign allocator (peak 25755648 bytes, memory_killed:true, return_code:-9), a 0.4 second watchdog kill (wall 0.518397375009954 seconds), and fork refusal (errno 35). These are platform-specific operational measurements.

All postflight manifest statuses were overwritten by the independent dirty-tree failure, so success/failure/resource terminal-classification end-to-end validity is incomplete even though raw outcomes are preserved.
A separately labeled deterministic metadata test with return_code:0 and group_quiescent:false produced (completed_valid,true,None) from _classify. No real nonquiescent child was launched.

format_version:true and maximum_workers:true passed admission because const/equality comparisons accept Python boolean/integer equality. Zero timeout was accepted. The schema forbids null watchdog, so any incidence successor needs a separately justified finite process watchdog or a contract-preserving null path.
Three short actual processes produced peak_rss_bytes:0 despite executing the Python child, exposing a sampling-resolution limit. QA does not turn zero sampling into proof of zero memory.
findings.smallest_scoped_repair: Retain the observed resource mechanisms, require exact integer types, refuse unquiesced groups in final validity, preserve cause-specific terminal states with all postflight failures, and disclose RSS sampling uncertainty. Validate success/failure/timeout/memory classifications under a legitimate clean synthetic setup.
findings.title: Resource checks have scoped successes but terminal classification and schema types remain incomplete

findings.frozen_requirement: Literal ultra with actual model/provider/session provenance, complete required engineering tests, and no unsupported completion claim are part of the frozen task.
observations: The producer report records requested_reasoning_effort:medium while acknowledging the task handoff requires ultra. It leaves resolved_model_id/provider null in a deterministic helper block and supplies no actual producing-session model/effort/session binding. QA cannot infer the served producer model.

The same report sets protocol_deviations:[], protocol_complete:true, data_quality:good and requires_rerun:false despite disclosed missing memory enforcement and normal validate_lock->execute_locked coverage.

The producer evidence marks both profiles covered while admitting neither was exercised; reports provenance as an author-report requirement rather than testing adapter native receipt enforcement; and counts existing uncommitted scratch as postlaunch mutation coverage.

The archived evidence includes an aggregate test log and hashes for scratch files, but not the complete fixture input/output bytes needed to reproduce its meaningful observations. The snapshots bind twelve artifacts, not producer scratch. This QA supplies complete independent fixture bytes in synthetic-evidence.json.

The producer report describes a self-created epoch-2 claim despite the no-worker-claim/write-scope rule. This review records the report statement and empty-deviation contradiction; it does not reconstruct or decide the legality of the historical claim transaction outside the declared inputs.

Any successor must supply actual task-calibrated native provenance and demonstrate every claimed control through the admitted interface; obtain independent review of its committed snapshot.
